correctness.rationale: Exponential edge-weight exploration in a complete (m+1)-vertex petal is an SI pure-birth chain with rates r_k=k(m+1-k), independent waiting times Exp(r_k), and random hub infection rank J uniform 1..m independent of waiting times. Distinct petals share only the already infected hub, giving independent hub-source completion Y_m, M_n=max_i Y_m, and exact leaf-source H+max(R,M_(n-1)). For fixed m>=2 rates at k=1,m both equal m; convolution of these two exponentials with faster internal stages gives tail m(m-1)^2 t exp(-mt)+O_m(exp(-mt)) using telescope E exp(mZ)=(m-1)^2. n-times tail at b=(log n+loglog n+2log(m-1))/m gives Gumbel, with centered maximum UI from exponential bounds; independent H leads to convolution limit and E H=H_m/m. m=1 has single slow pole, no loglog and penalty 1-1/n. Independently checked telescope and harmonic means for m=2,3,4,8,12; the source program separately contains exact full-graph CTMC and Dijkstra simulations. Finite checks do not prove the asymptotics.
